Structures & Engineering

Explore related projects

Strong foundations. Stronger partnerships.

BOW Structures is the dedicated internal division of BOW Projects. It brings structural design, compliance and construction capability together, supporting coordinated delivery from foundations through to the superstructure.

How we can help

  • Structural design and rationalisation
  • Formwork design, temporary works and certification
  • Earthmoving, basements and retention systems
  • Formwork, reinforcement and post-tensioning
  • Concrete supply, placement and precast installation
  • Structure management and remedial works
